text: Bridget's youngest starts reception on Thursday. She's way more nervous than he is apparently. Text her that morning.
mai graduating fri, physio degree. her parents flying in from hanoi the day before
Elena said her manager is leaving at the end of the month and she might go for his job. Interviews are next Tuesday.
Zofia running the Cardiff half on Sunday. First one. Training's been rough, dodgy knee since August.
Note to self: Aditi's daughter has her grade 5 piano exam tomorrow afternoon. Wish her luck tonight, and ask Aditi how it went the next day.
Tadhg's band playing the Fleece next Saturday, he put me on the guest list
so Hannah told me at lunch that Suzanne from accounts got the promotion, not her. she's gutted but trying to be cool about it. I should take her for a coffee next week
Lars — vegetarian, doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the client dinner Thursday.
Yusuf's son Ibrahim got his GCSE results back, all 7s and 8s. Yusuf was beaming. Send congrats.
pick up dry cleaning before friday

Gintaras is moving to the Leeds office in a fortnight. His wife Zofia got a job at the hospital there so they're relocating the whole family, kids changing schools mid-year and everything. He seems fine but she's anxious about it. Leaving drinks the Wednesday before at the Crown, I said I'd sort the card and collection.
Hoang Nguyen, new client contact at the agency. Prefers calls to email. Big Arsenal fan.

Okay so voice note. Phoebe's play opens this weekend, it's the school production of Annie and she's playing Miss Hannigan. Her mum Kate said she's been practising lines every night and is completely terrified. Opening night is Friday. I'm going Saturday with Michael. Must get flowers to give her afterwards.
Kiri's hen do is cancelled, the wedding's been pushed to spring
victor passed his driving test!! third time lucky. ring him tonight
Heather mentioned her dad's having his hip done on Monday. She's taking the week off to look after him. Check in Wednesday maybe.
Yara starts uni in Glasgow next week. Studying architecture. Her mum Natasha is not coping well about it lol
Gareth and his wife Olivia are doing the Great North Run together in September. Their first race as a couple.
Must remember to ask Nikhil how the pitch to Morris & Co went yesterday.
Grace's little boy Kenji had his first swimming gala this morning, came second in backstroke. She sent a video. Super proud.

julia from design pulled me aside after standup. struggling a bit. says her new manager thomas micromanages everything, rewrites her copy, cc's his boss on everything. shes not sleeping and has started looking at other jobs. dont mention any of it in the team meeting thursday. maybe suggest lunch next week, just the two of us, somewhere away from the office
Mihai's choir concert is Thursday 7pm at St Mary's. He's doing a solo. Said he's dreading it.

Beatriz has her PhD viva next Friday. Four years of work on coastal erosion, and her external examiner is apparently notoriously harsh, so she's barely sleeping. Then she flies to Lisbon the day after to see her family and decompress. Message her a week after to see how it all went, not before, she said she doesn't want to talk about it.
Kate's twins start secondary tomorrow. Different schools. She's a wreck.
gym 7am tomorrow, then dentist at 11
Bridget Novak's retiring after 30 years, do is on the 14th. Collection going round, chip in £10
Suzanne mentioned she's after a decent pair of running headphones, the ones she has keep falling out. Birthday's in a few weeks.
Zofia did it!! 2h04 at Cardiff. Knee held up. Message her tomorrow when she's recovered, she was wiped.
elena didnt get the role, they went external. shes ok about it she says but sounded flat. ring her at the weekend
Lars has a dog called Biscuit, a beagle. Biscuit's getting neutered on Tuesday.
Meeting with Aditi and her boss on Monday about the Schmidt account. They want to push the deadline back a fortnight.
Tadhg's gig was brilliant. They're recording an EP in November, he wants me to come to the launch.
Hannah's eldest, Grace, graduates from Durham in July. Law. Hannah's already planning a big lunch for afterwards.
Yusuf off sick all week, back injury. Kiri is covering his clients. Need to send him a get well card.
Phoebe smashed it apparently, standing ovation on the Friday. Kate cried. I still need to get those flowers sorted for Saturday
Heather says her dad's op went well, home already. She's relieved. He's on crutches for six weeks.

Nikhil and Julia are both up for the regional sales award. Ceremony is a week Friday at some hotel in Birmingham, black tie, which Nikhil is moaning about because he'll have to hire a suit. He reckons Julia's got it in the bag after landing the Schmidt contract. Either way there'll be drinks afterwards, and I'm driving them both up that afternoon.
Don't forget to text Victor good luck the morning of his interview at Nakamura. Tuesday 10am.
Kiri and Gareth's housewarming next Saturday, bring wine. Kiri's off gluten so maybe something else for the food.

Meeting Mai's parents for the first time on Friday at her graduation lunch. Things to remember: her dad is a massive jazz fan, been playing sax for 40 years, loves Coltrane. Her mum doesn't eat seafood, which rules out half the menu. They're both quite formal, call them Mr and Mrs Le until told otherwise. Mai's sister Yara is coming too, she's just started at Edinburgh doing medicine.

Ok dictating this in the car. Beatriz rang, viva went really well, minor corrections only, so she's basically Dr Beatriz now. She's in Lisbon till Sunday then back to start a postdoc at Imperial in January. Her partner Mihai is organising a surprise dinner the weekend she gets back. I need to keep that Saturday free and must not let slip to her.
Thomas off to Berlin Tuesday to Thursday for the conference. Wants a call the day before to go over the slides.
Olivia's mum passed away on Sunday. Funeral is probably next week, she'll let us know. Sort a card from the team.
School sports day Friday, I'm doing the parents' race. Again. Need trainers that aren't falling apart.

Grace mentioned Kenji has his first proper football match on Saturday, under 8s, away at Ashgrove. He's been talking about nothing else, sleeps in the kit. Grace's husband is the assistant coach so the whole family's going. Kenji keeps asking if I'll come. I could probably make the second half if I leave the client lunch early, and I should text Grace the night before to check the kick-off time.
Natasha Le, Yara's mum, works as a midwife at the Royal. Lovely. Lives on the same road as Hoang.
Must ask Zofia's husband how her knee's doing — she won't admit it's still sore.
Kenji's school photos came back, Grace wants me to see them, she's very pleased
aditi's lad got a merit on his piano exam!! she's chuffed. he wants to do grade 6 next
call Mrs Suzuki back re the after school club fees
Suzanne's leaving us for a startup. Last day is a week Friday. She's excited but nervous about the pay cut. Card and a bottle of something.
Michael and his husband Lars are flying to Japan in a fortnight for their 10th anniversary. Two weeks, Tokyo then Kyoto. I should get them a little something for the trip, maybe a guide book.
Gintaras's daughter has an audition for the National Youth Orchestra next Wednesday, cello. He's more nervous than she is. Ask him the day after.
Heather's son passed his 11+, got into the grammar. Very low key about it, didn't want a fuss.
Ibrahim Morris from the client side is a nightmare. Second time this month he's moved the review meeting. Now Thursday.
Julia won the award!! Nikhil was right. Drinks Friday to celebrate, everyone's going.

Kate rang. Her mum's had a fall, nothing broken but in hospital overnight. Kate's driving down tomorrow and staying through the weekend. Text her Sunday to see how things are. Also Phoebe's offered to look after their cat Pepper while she's away, sweet.
Tadhg's been learning Irish again, doing Duolingo every night. Wants to be fluent by the time his niece is born in March.

Long chat with Hoang today at the quarterly review. The project's back on track, which is a relief after the mess in the summer. He's got a new boss starting Monday, Victor Zhou, who's apparently a stickler for numbers so we need to have the dashboard tidied up by then. Hoang himself is going on paternity leave in about six weeks, baby due mid December. Remind me to get a gift for the baby before he goes.
bridget's grandson's christening Sunday, she asked me to be there. 11am at St Anne's
